constants.comment: suppose 5 tokens then theres 5x32 rows, the model can look 32 texts at once
constants.name: context_len

constants.comment: size of the vector that flows through the entire model with same width at each layer
constants.name: emb_dim

constants.comment: emb_dim must be divisible by this, model splits each vector into 2 halves of 16 numbers and runs attention separately
constants.name: num_heads

constants.comment: in the feed forward step, vector is stretched from 32 to 128 temporarily to allow model compute richer things
constants.name: ff_dim

constants.comment: number of layers of the LLM
constants.name: num_layers

constants.comment: each training example is a 16 rows table, we cut the input corpus into pieces of 16 tokens
constants.name: seq_len

constants.comment: tiny number added inside layer norm so we never divide by zero
constants.name: ln_eps

constants.comment: file the text is read from
constants.name: corpus_path

constants.comment: which column of the csv holds the text
constants.name: corpus_column

constants.comment: only read this many rows, keeps training fast
constants.name: max_rows

constants.comment: how many times BPE glues the most common pair into a new token, more merges = bigger vocab
constants.name: num_merges

constants.comment: last 10% of the token stream is kept aside to test the model on text it never trained on
constants.name: val_fraction

constants.comment: how far the window slides each time, 1 = every possible window (neighbours overlap by 15 tokens)
constants.name: stride

constants.comment: how many windows we average the gradient over before one update
constants.name: batch_size

constants.comment: how many full passes over the training windows
constants.name: epochs

constants.comment: if the whole gradient is longer than this, shrink it to this length so one bad batch cant blow up the model
constants.name: grad_clip

constants.comment: biggest learning rate, reached right after warmup
constants.name: lr_max

constants.comment: smallest learning rate, where the cosine decay ends
constants.name: lr_min

constants.comment: number of steps spent ramping the learning rate up from near 0, a fresh model is fragile
constants.name: warmup_steps

constants.comment: how much of the old gradient direction Adam keeps (momentum)
constants.name: beta1

constants.comment: how much of the old squared gradient Adam keeps (typical gradient size)
constants.name: beta2

constants.comment: tiny number so Adam never divides by zero
constants.name: adam_eps

constants.comment: each step shrinks the weight matrices slightly, only matrices, not biases or layer norm
constants.name: weight_decay

constants.comment: below 1 = safer and more repetitive, above 1 = more random, 0 = always pick the top token
constants.name: temperature

constants.comment: only sample from the k most likely tokens, 0 = turned off
constants.name: top_k

constants.comment: only sample from the smallest group of tokens whose probabilities add up to 0.9
constants.name: top_p

constants.comment: how many tokens talk.py writes after your prompt
constants.name: max_new_tokens

constants.comment: fixes the random numbers so a run can be repeated exactly
constants.name: seed

constants.comment: width of one head, 32 / 2 = 16
constants.name: head_dim
